rationale: Four independent lines follow printed stems and sustained values. Staff lanes are six because voices 2 and 3 cross staff. No all-rest spare lanes; unprinted gaps use forward, not rests. Retain sparse staff-lanes: voice 2 lower at 48-49; voice 3 upper at 50 and 53. Consolidation never moves fingering/slur ownership off its exact member.

cross_staff_guides.meaning: Printed diagonal association of the continuing inner line; not a sounding glissando.
cross_staff_guides.treatment: Preserve voice 3 continuity; retain guide description as MusicXML miscellaneous evidence and human representation question.

cross_staff_guides.meaning: Printed diagonal association of continuing lower line into upper staff; not a glissando.
cross_staff_guides.treatment: Preserve voice 3 continuity and separate beam groups; retain guide description as MusicXML miscellaneous evidence and human representation question.
